SERVICES AND SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into between Acme Analytics Sdn. Bhd. ("Supplier")
and Northwind Logistics Ltd. ("Client").

1. Definitions

1.1 "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by
one party to the other, whether orally, in writing or in machine-readable form.

1.2 "Deliverable" means any software, report, model or dataset that the
Supplier produces specifically for the Client under this Agreement.

2. Fees and Payment

2.1 Payment Terms

The Client shall pay undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.
All amounts are stated exclusive of any applicable sales and service tax.

2.2 Late Payment

A late charge of one and one half percent (1.5%) per month may accrue on
overdue undisputed amounts.

3. Term and Termination

3.1 Termination for Convenience

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days
written notice to the other party.

3.2 Termination for Cause

A party may terminate immediately if the other party commits a material breach
and fails to cure that breach within fifteen (15) days of written notice.

4. Confidentiality

Each party shall protect the other party's Confidential Information using no
less than a reasonable degree of care and shall not disclose it to third
parties except as required by law.

5. Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of Malaysia, and the parties submit to
the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Kuala Lumpur.
